# Third-party components

- LovyanGFX 1.2.7: see `LovyanGFX-LICENSE.txt`; source at https://github.com/lovyan03/LovyanGFX/tree/1.2.7 .
- Arduino-ESP32 2.0.17: LGPL 2.1 or later; see `Arduino-ESP32-LICENSE.md`; source at https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/tree/2.0.17 .
- The Arduino framework includes Espressif ESP-IDF components and binary libraries with their respective licenses: https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf/tree/v4.4.7 .

The complete game source and pinned build configuration are supplied so the firmware can be rebuilt with modified library sources. Dependency source is downloaded by PlatformIO; it is not duplicated in this archive.
